title: Can I BEAT Fog of War Chess?
summary: Fog of War: you only see squares your pieces can move to; win by capturing the king (no check rules - you may move into or stay in check). He fianchettoes bishops for vision and wins three games, the last by king capture.
rules: You see only your own pieces and squares they can legally move to (including captures); everything else is fogged.
There is no check: moving into check is allowed; the game is won by capturing the enemy king.
Castling through/into check appears permitted (6:05, inferred).
